exposure: Gestational age at COVID-19 diagnosis, Immigrant status
cohort: 176 pregnant women and 68 newborns diagnosed with COVID-19 between March 11, 2020 and February 11, 2022.
finding: The study found that COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with a higher cesarean section rate, and that immigrant women with COVID-19 had a higher incidence of complications and lower rates of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 diagnosed at a lower gestational age had higher rates of cesarean section.
gest_age: Various, but mentioned "low gestational week" as a factor
